title: Cycloastragenol attenuates osteoarthritis by restoring chondrocyte senescence via the NRF2/NF-kappaB signaling axis.
authors: Zhang, Shuhao; Zou, Yanlong; Long, Jundong; Wang, Yufan; Chen, Jian; Teng, Miao
one_liner_zh: 该文研究环黄芪醇通过NRF2/NF-kappaB信号轴改善骨关节炎软骨细胞衰老，仅涉及小分子-蛋白对接，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Osteoarthritis (OA) involves oxidative stress-induced chondrocyte senescence and extracellular matrix (ECM) dysregulation, yet disease-modifying therapies remain elusive. This study investigates the effects of cycloastragenol (CAG), a telomerase-activating triterpenoid from Astragalus membranaceus, on OA progression with a focus on NRF2/NF-kappaB signaling. In vitro, CAG suppressed oxidative stress-induced senescence in primary rat chondrocytes, evidenced by reduced SA-beta-gal positivity, partially restored EdU proliferation, and downregulated senescence related proteins expression. In addition, CAG concurrently attenuated senescence-associated secretory phenotype (SASP) and partially restored ECM homeostasis. Mechanistically, molecular docking analysis suggested a potential interaction between CAG and the Kelch domain of KEAP1. Consistent with this, CAG treatment was associated with NRF2 pathway activation and attenuation of TBHP-induced NF-kappaB signaling. Importantly, genetic inhibition of NRF2 significantly attenuated the protective effects of CAG, supporting a required role for NRF2 in mediating CAG-induced suppression of oxidative stress and inflammatory signaling. In vivo, intra-articular CAG administration in monosodium iodoacetate (MIA)-induced OA rats reduced cartilage degradation, rescued ECM homeostasis, and enhanced NRF2 activation. Collectively, CAG mitigates the degradation of the extracellular matrix and suppresses the senescence-associated secretory phenotype (SASP) induced by osteoarthritis (OA).
abstract_zh: 骨关节炎（OA）涉及氧化应激诱导的软骨细胞衰老和细胞外基质（ECM）失调，然而疾病修饰疗法仍难以实现。本研究探讨了来自黄芪的端粒酶激活三萜类化合物环黄芪醇（CAG）对OA进展的影响，重点关注NRF2/NF-kappaB信号通路。在体外实验中，CAG抑制了原代大鼠软骨细胞中氧化应激诱导的衰老，表现为SA-β-gal阳性率降低、EdU增殖部分恢复以及衰老相关蛋白表达下调。此外，CAG同时减弱了衰老相关分泌表型（SASP）并部分恢复ECM稳态。机制上，分子对接分析提示CAG与KEAP1的Kelch结构域之间存在潜在相互作用。与此一致，CAG处理与NRF2通路激活及TBHP诱导的NF-kappaB信号减弱相关。重要的是，NRF2的遗传抑制显著削弱了CAG的保护作用，支持NRF2在介导CAG诱导的氧化应激和炎症信号抑制中发挥必要作用。在体内实验中，单碘乙酸（MIA）诱导的OA大鼠关节内注射CAG减少了软骨降解，恢复了ECM稳态，并增强了NRF2激活。总体而言，CAG减轻了细胞外基质的降解，并抑制了骨关节炎（OA）诱导的衰老相关分泌表型（SASP）。
